correctness.rationale: For a complete multipartite graph, the r-independence faces are exactly the (r-1)-skeleton plus complete part simplices. The long exact sequence relative to the skeleton gives H~_(r-1) = wedge^r U / sum_i wedge^r U_i, and basis vectors e_v-e_rep_i show the partwise sum is a primitive direct summand over Z. This proves torsion-freeness. Permutation exterior-character determinants give the full trace. For H=product_i S_{m_i}, the invariant quotient reduces to wedge^r W where W is the part-constant augmentation module; letting the equal-sized-part permutation factors act, its invariant component is wedge^r Q^(t-1), so the full geometric quotient rational Betti rank is binom(t-1,r). At r=1 this reduces to the number of part orbits minus one; at r>=N the simplex is contractible. Fresh independent finite homology profiles agree in 16 parameter/threshold instances; no finite computation replaces the general chain proof.
residual_risks: Both part sizes and all r must be interpreted with out-of-range exterior powers zero; orbit-space assertion is rational, not integral.
